content.json:
# Azure Key Vault Security Dashboard
---

This dashboard provides comprehensive monitoring of Azure Key Vault secrets, including expiration tracking, access patterns, and security audit trails.

parameters.name: KeyVault
parameters.label: Key Vault
parameters.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT"
| distinct Resource
| order by Resource asc

content.query:
KeyVaultSecretExpiry_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where KeyVaultName_s == '{KeyVault}' or '{KeyVault}' == 'All'
| extend DaysUntilExpiry = datetime_diff('day', ExpirationDate_t, now())
| extend Status = case(
    DaysUntilExpiry < 0, "Expired",
    DaysUntilExpiry <= 7, "Critical (≤7 days)",
    DaysUntilExpiry <= 30, "Warning (≤30 days)",
    DaysUntilExpiry <= 90, "Notice (≤90 days)",
    "OK"
)
| summarize Count = count() by Status
| order by Count desc
content.title: Secrets by Expiration Status

content.query:
KeyVaultSecretExpiry_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where KeyVaultName_s == '{KeyVault}' or '{KeyVault}' == 'All'
| extend DaysUntilExpiry = datetime_diff('day', ExpirationDate_t, now())
| extend Status = case(
    DaysUntilExpiry < 0, 1,
    DaysUntilExpiry <= 7, 2,
    DaysUntilExpiry <= 30, 3,
    DaysUntilExpiry <= 90, 4,
    5
)
| summarize 
    Expired = countif(Status == 1),
    Critical = countif(Status == 2),
    Warning = countif(Status == 3),
    Notice = countif(Status == 4),
    OK = countif(Status == 5)
content.title: Secret Status Summary

content.query:
KeyVaultSecretExpiry_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where KeyVaultName_s == '{KeyVault}' or '{KeyVault}' == 'All'
| extend DaysUntilExpiry = datetime_diff('day', ExpirationDate_t, now())
| where DaysUntilExpiry <= 90
| extend Status = case(
    DaysUntilExpiry < 0, "🔴 Expired",
    DaysUntilExpiry <= 7, "🟠 Critical",
    DaysUntilExpiry <= 30, "🟡 Warning",
    DaysUntilExpiry <= 90, "🔵 Notice",
    "🟢 OK"
)
| project 
    Status,
    SecretName = SecretName_s,
    KeyVault = KeyVaultName_s,
    ExpirationDate = format_datetime(ExpirationDate_t, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
    DaysRemaining = DaysUntilExpiry,
    LastUpdated = format_datetime(LastUpdated_t, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
| order by DaysUntilExpiry asc
content.title: ⚠️ Secrets Expiring Within 90 Days

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT"
| where Resource == '{KeyVault}' or '{KeyVault}' == 'All'
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationName has_any ("SecretGet", "SecretSet", "SecretList", "SecretDelete")
| summarize 
    TotalOperations = count(),
    SecretGets = countif(OperationName == "SecretGet"),
    SecretSets = countif(OperationName == "SecretSet"),
    SecretLists = countif(OperationName == "SecretList"),
    SecretDeletes = countif(OperationName == "SecretDelete")
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render timechart
content.title: Key Vault Operations Over Time

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT"
| where Resource == '{KeyVault}' or '{KeyVault}' == 'All'
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationName == "SecretGet"
| extend SecretName = extract(@"secrets/([^/]+)", 1, id_s)
| where isnotempty(SecretName)
| summarize AccessCount = count() by SecretName
| top 10 by AccessCount desc
| render barchart
content.title: Top 10 Most Accessed Secrets

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT"
| where Resource == '{KeyVault}' or '{KeyVault}' == 'All'
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationName has_any ("SecretGet", "SecretSet", "SecretList", "SecretDelete")
| extend SecretName = extract(@"secrets/([^/]+)", 1, id_s)
| extend CallerIdentity = coalesce(identity_claim_upn_s, identity_claim_appid_g, "Unknown")
| extend Success = iff(ResultSignature == "OK", "✅ Success", "❌ Failed")
| project 
    TimeGenerated,
    Operation = OperationName,
    SecretName,
    Caller = CallerIdentity,
    CallerIP = CallerIPAddress,
    Success,
    ResultDescription
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Recent Key Vault Activity (Last 100 Operations)

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT"
| where Resource == '{KeyVault}' or '{KeyVault}' == 'All'
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResultSignature != "OK"
| extend SecretName = extract(@"secrets/([^/]+)", 1, id_s)
| summarize FailedAttempts = count() by CallerIPAddress, identity_claim_upn_s, OperationName, ResultDescription
| order by FailedAttempts desc
| take 20
content.title: ⚠️ Failed Access Attempts

content.query:
AzureMetrics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT"
| where Resource == '{KeyVault}' or '{KeyVault}' == 'All'
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where MetricName == "Availability"
| summarize AvgAvailability = avg(Average), MinAvailability = min(Minimum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| render timechart
content.title: Key Vault Availability (%)

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT"
| where Resource == '{KeyVault}' or '{KeyVault}' == 'All'
| where OperationName == "SecretGet"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| extend SecretName = extract(@"secrets/([^/]+)", 1, id_s)
| summarize LastAccess = max(TimeGenerated) by SecretName
| where LastAccess < ago(90d) or isempty(LastAccess)
| extend DaysSinceLastAccess = datetime_diff('day', now(), LastAccess)
| project SecretName, LastAccess, DaysSinceLastAccess
| order by DaysSinceLastAccess desc
content.title: 🔍 Unused Secrets (No Access in 90+ Days)
